verses.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

segments.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

verses.text: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

segments.text: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

verses.text: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.

segments.text: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.

verses.text: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

segments.text: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

verses.text: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

segments.text: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

verses.text: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

segments.text: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

verses.text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

segments.text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

verses.text: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

segments.text: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

verses.text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

segments.text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
